design: Use the existing peak decoder and learned red/blue heat probabilities as detection scores, accepting at fixed0.5 before incumbent geometry selection. One2342parameter full-frame model, no MSER search and no crop classifier. Compare parent plus both control/balanced seeds against the prior hybrid. No threshold sweep or model selection from heldout results.
hypothesis: Direct heat predictions may avoid classification and localization disagreement while removing per-crop inference; their TRAIN false positives and recall determine whether this route merits dedicated detector retraining.
gate: Both balanced seeds must preserve all incumbent targets, not add per-color false positives on any TRAIN panel, and recover at least one target overall before separate export/development investigation. Report structural inference reduction but no FPS estimate without on-device measurements.
